claim: M701 demand-aware RPM-onset hazard; pre-registered verdict supported=false (sign condition fails; CV gain and AUC gain positive)

reproduced.estimate_note: log HR pedal P75 vs P25 (day-weighted quantiles 0 vs 14.9); HR 1.26 [0.97,1.64]; score-bootstrap log CI [-0.028,0.492]

agreement_detail: counts within 0.7 % (drives 430 vs 427, blocks +0.4 %, events +0.25 %, days 73=73); logHR 0.234 inside author CI (-0.22..0.31), CIs overlap; CV gain 16.2 inside author CI 13.6-26.1; AUC level differs (0.800/0.699 vs 0.850/0.777) but gain positive in both. Pre-registered verdict reproduced: both HR intervals include 0, CV gain and AUC gain intervals exclude 0.
method_concerns: hr_scalar uses unweighted np.nanpercentile for P25/P75; spec item 5 says day-weighted. My day-weighted run gives logHR 0.234 vs author 0.043: the point estimate is quantile-definition sensitive (pedal mass at 0); verdict unaffected.
winsor bounds computed on all rows before CV (outcome-independent, covariate-only; minor fold contamination of covariate quantiles, no outcome leakage).
AUC computed on p/w (per-second hazard) pooled over blocks of width 1 or 2; my block-level AUC is lower by ~0.05-0.08; AUC is secondary, not a gate.

Eligibility: feasibility CSV pedEligible=228/44 days is computed without LOCF; the study uses post-LOCF coverage (430/73). Spec says after LOCF, consistent, but the CSV and the study disagree and the CHANGELOG feasibility count should be labelled pre-LOCF.

Leakage checked: covariates at k-1 (rollmax shift(1), at_start k-1), folds are whole days stratified by month, models refit per fold, day is cluster for sandwich, score bootstrap and CV bootstrap; no row-level resampling found. Reverse-mask alignment tolerance 1 s (disclosed). Cold-class and epoch confounding unaddressed in fit (pedal only from Aug 13 onward).
language_concerns: Report 'not established' for the pedal sign (HR CI spans 1), not 'no effect'.
CV gain and AUC gain are predictive value beyond SoC/speed/duration, not a pedal effect; do not call it consistent with the OEM statement (verdict is supported=false).
Say 'RPM onset', not 'engine start'; epoch/firmware/cadence confounded.
